title: Sustainable Urban Housing: A Post-Pandemic Framework
shortDescription: Research thesis exploring adaptive reuse strategies in metropolitan housing.
description: This thesis examines how urban housing can be redesigned to accommodate changing work patterns and social behaviors emerging from the pandemic era. The research proposes a flexible framework for multi-use residential spaces that can adapt to hybrid work arrangements and changing household compositions.

title: Vernacular Architecture of the Mediterranean
shortDescription: Study of traditional building techniques and their relevance to contemporary design.
description: This research paper documents the traditional architectural practices of Mediterranean coastal communities and analyzes their potential application in sustainable modern design. The study focuses on passive cooling techniques, local material utilization, and the social organization of traditional settlements.

title: Parametric Facade Design Workshop
shortDescription: Advanced studio exploring algorithmic approaches to building envelope design.
description: A semester-long studio project investigating computational methods for facade optimization. The workshop combined traditional architectural principles with parametric design tools to develop responsive building envelopes that respond to solar orientation, privacy requirements, and structural considerations.

title: Adaptive Reuse of Industrial Heritage
shortDescription: Case study analysis of factory-to-cultural-center conversions.
description: This conference paper presents a comparative analysis of industrial heritage adaptive reuse projects across Europe and North America. The research identifies successful strategies for preserving architectural character while meeting contemporary functional and accessibility requirements.

title: Community Design Build: Youth Center
shortDescription: Collaborative design-build studio creating a community youth center.
description: A collaborative studio project involving architecture students and local youth organizations to design and partially construct a community youth center. The project emphasized participatory design processes and hands-on construction experience for students while addressing genuine community needs.
